data_description.z2m_url:
Lets "Z2M" in the panel open a device's page in Zigbee2MQTT, in a drawer over the map.

Enter the address of the **Zigbee2MQTT frontend** (not Home Assistant's) as your browser reaches it, with http:// or https://.

**Home Assistant OS or Supervised:** the Zigbee2MQTT app's frontend port, e.g. http://homeassistant:8099. The port is off by default: [open the app](https://my.home-assistant.io/redirect/supervisor_addon/?addon=45df7312_zigbee2mqtt) → Configuration → Network → "Show disabled ports" → enter 8099 next to the frontend port → Save → restart the app.

**Core or Container:** the address of your Zigbee2MQTT instance's frontend, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:8080.

Home Assistant on https cannot embed a Zigbee2MQTT frontend on plain http; Ctrl-click then opens a tab.
